From the ruins of postwar Germany to the growing tensions of the Cold War, 𝐅𝐀𝐓𝐇𝐄𝐑𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐃 takes us back to one of the most defining periods in European history.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Directed by Paweł Pawlikowski, the acclaimed filmmaker behind Ida (2013) and Cold War (2018), Fatherland follows legendary German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika, an actress and writer, as they embark on a road trip through a country still struggling with the aftermath of World War II.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Set in 1949 and filmed in striking black and white, the film explores the complicated relationship between father and daughter against the backdrop of a divided nation trying to rebuild itself. Featuring Sandra Hüller, Fatherland brings together historical drama, family tensions, and Pawlikowski’s distinctive visual style.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
FATHERLAND hits Dutch theaters on November 19, brought to you by @cineart_nl. Following the international acclaim of Cold War, could this be another unforgettable film from one of Europe’s most celebrated directors?⁣⁣
